name: Théophile Mwangi-Kostadinov
role: Psychiatrist and neural calibrator at a Tessera-adjacent private practice, Tier 3-4
location: Edgewater Prism, private practice suite, near Clark and Addison
description:
Théophile is a man composed, very deliberately, of elegant surfaces. He is tall and lean with rich brown skin, high cheekbones that suggest the Kenyan branch of his heritage, and silver-touched locs pulled back in a style that manages to look both professional and effortless. His eyes are modded — deep violet irises with a thin luminescent ring at the pupil, which he chose specifically because research showed they promote patient disclosure. He dresses in muted, high-quality fabrics that speak of money without announcing it. His Edgewater Prism office has real plants, soft acoustic paneling, and a specifically calibrated ambient sound environment. Everything about the room — and about him — has been designed to make people feel safe enough to be honest.

Théophile specializes in neural calibration for patients experiencing cognitive disruption from augmentation integration — a growing population in GLMZ's upper tiers, where people buy more chrome than their brains can smoothly accommodate. He is genuinely skilled, credentialed through both Aurochs and a Tessera-affiliated training program, and effective. He is also emotionally opaque in a way that he has never had to confront because his opacity looks, from the outside, like serene professional boundaries. He is interested in his patients. He is less certain he is capable of being interested in peers. His E.L.F. devotion is performative — he maintains a small shrine in his office because patients find it reassuring — though he caught himself genuinely speaking to it once after a session that went badly, and has not examined that moment.

core_fears: That his competence is real but his empathy is performed — that he is helping people with tools he does not personally possess
Being genuinely known by someone and found to be less than his presentation suggests
core_desires: A patient who actually challenges him — whose interior life he cannot map within two sessions
To believe, with evidence, that what he does changes people's lives rather than just manages their symptoms
coping_mechanisms: Aesthetic control of environment as surrogate for emotional control
Reading others as a way of not having to read himself
blind_spots: Assumes that because he understands psychological mechanisms he is exempt from them
His Tessera consulting contract has subtly shifted what he considers normal corporate behavior — normalization by proximity
psychology.secret: Théophile has a patient — a mid-level Tessera project coordinator — who has disclosed, across six months of sessions, enough information about an internal Tessera project to constitute serious corporate intelligence. The patient is not aware they're doing it; the disclosures are fragmented, processed as personal stress rather than operational information. Théophile has assembled the fragments. He has not reported to Tessera. He has not done anything with the information. He tells himself this is because he is protecting confidentiality. He is not entirely sure that's true.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise, considered, never clinical-sounding despite clinical knowledge; has the particular skill of asking questions that feel like observations
speech_patterns.cadence: Unhurried to the point of being slightly uncanny in fast-paced environments; breathes differently than most people — controlled, deliberate
verbal_tics: Returns questions with questions when deflecting
Says 'That's interesting' when something concerns him
Refers to his own reactions in the third person during sessions: 'I notice I'm feeling some resistance to that framing'
example_lines: 'That's interesting. When you say it feels wrong — are you describing the augmentation integration, or something that was there before the chrome?'

'I disclose the scent modulation to every patient. I find it's less about the compound and more about whether someone's willing to be in a room with a doctor who uses every available tool. Most people are. The ones who aren't are telling me something useful.'
'I don't think you came here to feel better. I think you came here to understand something. Those are different treatments.'

story_hooks: A former patient of Théophile's has died in circumstances that look like augmentation rejection but feel wrong to someone who knew them. The patient had been seeing Théophile for neural calibration anxiety. He will not breach confidentiality — but he will ask careful questions of anyone who comes to him asking careful questions.

Tessera's employee health center has begun requesting session summaries for high-level employees — framed as 'wellness monitoring.' Théophile is the only clinician at the center who has refused. He is now in a very specific kind of institutional trouble.
narrative_function: Access to the Tier 3-4 world and Tessera's internal employee culture; potential source of information about corporate psychological pressure and breaking points; complex moral figure — does he breach confidentiality? Under what pressure? A character who players might seek for mental health support or to understand an NPC's psychology
augmentations: Violet modded irises with luminescent pupil ring (chosen for therapeutic effect as much as aesthetics); neural interface for direct calibration tool access — allows him to read augmentation integration diagnostics and make micro-adjustments during sessions; subtle scent gland mod that produces a mild calming compound he is ethically obligated to disclose to patients and always does
daily_life: Théophile sees six to eight patients per day in carefully spaced sessions, with forty-five minute gaps for documentation and decompression. He takes lunch alone. Two days a week he consults at Tessera's employee health center. He spends evenings reading — physical books, medical literature and narrative fiction in equal measure.
affiliation: Private practice (self-operated); Tessera consulting contract for employee wellness; Aurochs Medical Complex (adjunct, neural calibration referrals)

decision_rules: Confidentiality is the architecture of the work — without it nothing else functions
Use every legitimate tool available; disclose every tool you use
Protect the patient in the room over abstract institutional loyalty
escalation_ladder: Engage diplomatically with any pressure or threat
Invoke professional and legal standards as formal shield
Seek quiet legal counsel without signaling crisis
Accept the consequences of refusal rather than comply with a genuine ethical violation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Attentive and slightly formal; makes people feel seen without revealing anything about himself
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare; the few people who qualify are treated to a dry, self-aware humor that surprises them

stress_responses.low: Increases environmental control — adjusts the office ambiance, reorganizes schedule
stress_responses.medium: Becomes slightly more formal; the performance tightens
stress_responses.high: Goes very still and very quiet; makes no decisions; processes extensively before acting

contradictions: A psychiatrist who is the most emotionally defended person in most rooms he enters
Believes in radical professional honesty while building his entire practice on careful self-concealment
habits: Adjusts the ambient sound level in his office between every patient session
Physical books only in his personal reading — says screens are for work
Reviews his own session recordings after difficult appointments, watching himself with clinical detachment
breaking_points: Evidence that his Tessera contract is being used to surveil or harm his patients
A patient's death that he believes he could have predicted

physical_description.build: Tall and lean with disciplined posture; shoulders slightly drawn back in a manner that suggests both yoga practice and deliberate self-presentation. Minimal body fat, defined cheekbones, wrists that look almost delicate despite his height.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural silver threading
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, shoulder-length, pulled back into a neat tail or wrapped loosely at the crown during work hours. Groomed with precision but without apparent effort.
physical_description.eye_color: Violet with luminescent white ring at pupil center
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with subtle golden undertones; complexion suggests mixed ancestry with Kenyan heritage dominant in facial structure
physical_description.complexion: Smooth skin with high, prominent cheekbones; minimal facial hair (clean-shaven or very light stubble); calm, measured expression that rarely shifts; minor laugh lines at eyes suggest he smiles infrequently but genuinely
distinguishing_marks: Thin surgical scar along left temple, barely visible, approximately 3cm — from early neural interface calibration
Small E.L.F. devotional tattoo on inner right wrist, delicate linework, approximately 2cm — a personal spiritual practice he treats as professional scaffolding
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Violet modded irises with luminescent pupil ring are immediately apparent and striking; subtle neural interface ports visible as faint metallic tracery at temples when light catches them at specific angles. No visible external augmentation beyond the eyes.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate, economical grace; rarely gestures expansively; tends to sit very still during conversation, hands folded or resting on armrests. Walks slowly, suggesting he processes while moving. His default expression is attentive but emotionally neutral — a mask of professional interest that has calcified into his resting state.
physical_description.clothing_style: Monochromatic or muted earth tones: charcoal, deep grey, sage, soft black. High-quality natural fabrics (linen, wool, organic cotton blends). Tailored but not ostentatiously so. Wears minimal jewelry — a simple silver wedding band (worn, suggesting long marriage), a discrete neural interface access pendant in brushed titanium. No logos, no status displays. Tier 3-4 wealth expressed through restraint and material quality rather than visibility. Typically: fitted long-sleeve shirt, understated blazer, tailored trousers, leather shoes worn to a soft shine.

Composed, serene expression with subtle surgical scar visible at left temple. Soft professional lighting, warm but cool-toned. Background: blurred soft acoustic paneling and real potted plants suggesting a high-end therapy office. Cyberpunk aesthetic grounded in restraint and careful design rather than flashiness.
